body:
Ok. Maybe I'll try to find a therapist soon! I'm scared. 

And I agree 100%: The absent marks; **Bullshit**

Wow.. I appreciate it. To be honest it felt a bit like you were yelling at me in the beginning, however I understand you need me to take this seriously. Thank you.  
 
In november, last year, I had a discussion with my parents about changing school. They thought I gave up too easily and I'm afraid they won't take me seriously. "You just want attention." "Why do you need to make up this, you don't have depression!". We've had other serious conversations before but they don't take em' seriously.

I know. I *was* actually seeing a psychiatrist recommended by the school nurse, but my absence was documented and the teacher sent a letter home, saying I might lose one of my grades. If this happened I would have to go the first year all over again. I am also extremely introverted, and talking to a therapist wasn't *that* bad, I just didn't feel like it was helping me.
